description: A turn that cannot go on without a person stops and asks instead of guessing — two things with one name, a value nobody recorded, a confirmation. The question is a record; the answer continues the turn bound to it.

tool_definition.name: TDA_AskUser
tool_definition.description: Stop and ask the user ONE question you cannot answer from the conversation or your tools — a choice between things with the same name, a value nobody recorded, a confirmation of a step that cannot be undone. After this call the turn ends: end your answer by asking the question as written and call no further tools; the user's answer continues this request. Ask only when the answer changes what you do.

kind.description: choose (one of listed options) · provide (a typed value) · confirm (yes/no on a named step)

question.description: The question the user reads, in one sentence (at most 300 characters).

why.description: What it blocks, in one sentence.

options.description: choose only: 2–8 option labels, each unique (the label is the value the user picks).

schema.description: provide only: a flat JSON schema of one primitive field (string with format date/date-time/email/uri, number, integer, boolean, enum). Never a credential.
